alarms.action: Stops conveyor motor M-1001 (Y10) immediately and raises ST10 motor overload alarm (M191)
alarms.condition: Motor overload trip MOL-1001 opens (X13 low)
alarms.name: Motor overload

alarms.action: Conveyor stops and jam alarm (M190) is raised until reset
alarms.condition: Entry photo-eye PE-1002 stays blocked for more than 5.0 s while conveyor runs
alarms.name: Jam alarm

conflicts.narrative_says: Entry photo-eye PE-1002 blocked > 5.0 s while conveyor runs stops conveyor and sets jam alarm
conflicts.program_says: Missing / unprogrammed (no logic for PE-1002 or T10 in program; M190 reset exists on R2, but no rung sets M190)

conflicts.item: E-stop healthy contact polarity in trip rung R3
conflicts.narrative_says: E-stop chain stops conveyor immediately (healthy when X0 is made)
conflicts.program_says: R3 uses ORI X0 (causes fault trip M199 when E-stop X0 is healthy/closed instead of when lost)

interlocks.cause: Motor overload (MOL-1001, X13 lost) or E-stop chain lost (ES-0001, X0 lost) or not in auto mode (SS-0003, X2 low)
ST10 fault present (M190 or M191 active)

steps.entry: Line controller requests a release (RQ-1005, rising edge / X14)
steps.name: Stopper drop/release
